\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}

\begin{document}

\section{Introduction}
Let $k$ be a field and let $A$ be a finitely generated $k$-algebra; we write $\dim A$ for the Krull dimension of $A$.
We study $\dim A$ through Noether normalization.

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:finite}
  There are $x_1, \dots, x_d \in A$, algebraically independent
  over $k$, such that $A$ is finite over $k[x_1, \dots, x_d]$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
  Induction on the number of generators of $A$.
\end{proof}

\section{Consequences}
The Krull dimension of $A$ equals $d$.
